//: dev2 edge: which TLS names the nginx stream proxy hands to Caddy, and what Caddy does with them. Rendered by dev2/dev2-edge. Every upstream is the one nginx used before the move (2026-10-19). Certificates are NOT issued by Caddy: caddy-edge-certs copies the files the existing renewals (certbot, pit-proxy-cert, moshpit-renew) already keep current, and reloads Caddy when they change.

keep_on_nginx.//: Names under a routed pattern that stay on nginx for now, with why.
keep_on_nginx.live.streaming.pit.world: per-path routing to two nixamp servers with a 404 fallback (error_page @server2); move after it has its own Caddy rehearsal

sites.//: group.call (moshcoder/group.call): no gzip, so the room page's server-sent events are not held back; retry holds Telnyx webhooks across a deploy instead of 502
pit-proxy: every <name>.pit.world (+ bbs./social.) relayed by the pit.world app; one Let's Encrypt certificate per name from pit-proxy-cert
